title: rhamnus roylei
intro: Rhamnus roylei, commonly known as Royle's alder buckthorn, is a plant species in the family Rhamnaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of diabetes due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhamnus roylei include its anti-diarrheal, anti-bacterial, and anti-fungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rhamnus roylei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
